scope.ja: 孤立・Born–Oppenheimer・非相対論・2電子閉殻H₂。3核間距離でSTO-3Gと入れ子s型Gaussian基底を比較。RHFの数値検証であり、分子DFT・周期系・完全基底極限や正しい解離を検証しない。
scope.en: Isolated Born–Oppenheimer nonrelativistic two-electron closed-shell H₂. Compare STO-3G and nested s-Gaussian spaces at three separations. Numerical RHF validation, not molecular DFT, periodic, complete-basis or correct-dissociation validation.

caption.en: Fixed-input H₂ RHF: separate geometry, s-basis sequence and SCF-tolerance comparisons. Reading states PySCF differences, histories and remaining finite-basis limits.

note.ja: 教育用コードをimportしない独立PySCF。同一幾何・同一有限基底のRHFであり、相関を含む厳密解ではありません。
note.en: Independent PySCF imports no educational solver. Same-geometry, same-finite-basis RHF, not an exact correlated solution.

scope.ja: 固定した1原子単純立方Heセル（格子定数4 bohr、価電子2、非偏極LDA_X＋VWN5、局所GTH）。PySCFを使う実行・検証ワークフロー。11設定でk点・Gaussian軌道基底・FFT補助格子・SCFを別々に比較し、Γ／2³は独立DFTK平面波参照と照合。平衡He結晶・完全基底・金属・一般物質は未検証。
scope.en: Fixed one-atom simple-cubic He cell (lattice constant 4 bohr, two valence electrons, unpolarized LDA_X plus VWN5, local GTH). A PySCF execution/validation workflow. Eleven settings separately compare k sampling, Gaussian orbital basis, auxiliary FFT grid and SCF; Gamma and 2³ are compared with independent DFTK plane waves. Equilibrium helium, complete-basis, metals and general materials remain unvalidated.

caption.ja: 固定Heセルの周期LDA：Γ点とkメッシュ、Gaussian軌道基底・FFT格子・SCFを分離。DFTK平面波参照の打切り収束と差も表示。

note.en: Separately executed DFTK plane-wave KS-LDA at Gamma and 2³ for the same model, with cutoff convergence saved. Different finite orbital bases are compared within a stated tolerance, without machine-precision claims.
